text:
Product Overview
PM3027FSNR V2 has 24*10/100Mbps adaptive RJ45 ports, the uplink port is 1*1000Mbps Combo port and 1*10/100/1000Mbps RJ45 port, and each RJ45 port supports MDI/MDIX auto-flip and wire-speed forwarding. Among them, ports 1-24 have PoE power supply function ports 17-24 support remote transmission, support IEEE802.3af/at standard, the maximum power of the port can be up to 30W, and can be used as Power over Ethernet devices, which can automatically detect and identify the powered devices that comply with the standard, and supply power to them through the network cable. This product is simple and convenient to use, no need to configure, can meet the Enterprise, Community, Hotel, Office Network and Park Network Networking and access requirements.
Product Features
Supports 802.3af/at standard;
Single PoE port output power up to 30W;
Automatic detection PD equipment;
17-24 port 100Mbps data transmission and PoE power supply distance up to 300M (typical value), 10Mbps data transmission and PoE power supply distance up to 800M (used with remote equipment);
Supports one-click PD-ALIVE, VLAN, CCTV, SCP modes.
Support IEEE802.3x full duplex flow control and Backpressure half duplex flow control;
Support 8K MAC address, automatic learning and automatic update;
Panel indicator to monitor working status and help fault analysis;
Product Specifications
Hardware Specifications
Model	PM3027FSNR V2
Interface	24*10M/100Mbps RJ45 Ports / 1*1000Mbps Combo Ports(Electrical port can be adapted to 10M/100/1000Mbps)
1*10M/100M/1000Mbps RJ45 Uplink Port
Standard	IEEE802.3,IEEE802.3i,IEEE802.3u,IEEE802.3z,IEEE802.3ab,IEEE802.3x, IEEE802.3af, IEEE802.3at
Network Media(Cable)	10BASE-T: UTP category 3,4,5 cable(≤100m) / 100BASE-TX: UTP category 5, 5e cable(≤100m) / 1000BASE-X: UTP category 5e, 6 cable(≤100m) / 1000BASE-X: MMF, SMF
Indicator	PWR(Green), LNK/ACT(Green), PoE(Orange),PoE Max(Green)
MAC Address Table	8K, Auto-learning, Auto-update
Jumbo Frame	9216Byte
Packet Buffer	4Mbit
Transfer Mode	Store-and-Forward
Packet Forward Speed	6.55Mpps
Switching Capacity	8.8Gbps
Remote Port	Port 17~24
PoE Port	Port 1~24
PoE Power Output	30W (Max)
PoE Power On RJ45	1/2(+) 3/6(-), 4/5(+) 7/8(-)
PoE Power Budget	250W	185W
Power Supply	260W	200W
Lnput Power Supply	AC:100-240V, 50/60Hz
Dimensions(L*W*H)	280*180*44mm
Operating Temperature	0°C ~ 40°C
Storage Temperature	-40°C ~ 70°C
Operating Humidity	10% ~ 90% non-condensing
Storage Humidity	5% ~ 90% non-condensing
Surge Protection	Differential mode ±2KV,Common mode ±4KV
Electrostatic Standard	Contact ±6KV, Air ±8KV
MTBF	>50000 hours
Ordering Information
Product Information	24FE(PoE)+1GE+1G Combo Long-Range Unmanaged PoE Switch
Packaging Accessories	Power Cord *1 / User Manual *1 / Rack Mount Kit *2 / Feet *4 / Screw *8
